name: com.taipeiledger/ledger
title: Taipei Ledger
description: Taiwan-listed companies in English: monthly revenue, filings, supply chains and Japan links.

tools.name: find_company
tools.description:
Find Taiwan-listed companies by stock code (2330, 2330.TW), English name, nickname (Foxconn, TSMC) or Chinese
    name (台積電). Returns code, names, board (TWSE or TPEx), industry and the Taipei Ledger page.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description:
One company's profile: English and Chinese names, industry, founded and listed dates, website, an English
    description written from cited company sources, its latest monthly revenue with growth measures, its five most
    recent filings, and how many supply-chain, Japan and investment records exist.

tools.name: get_revenue
tools.description:
Monthly revenue history of one company (NT$, as filed with MOPS, from January 2021): revenue, year-on-year
    and month-on-month change per month, newest first, plus the latest month's measures (year to date, versus its
    own trend, how unusual, record month since, back to growth).

tools.name: screen_revenue
tools.description:
Screen every company on the latest month of revenue. Filters: industry (e.g. 'Semiconductors', 'Computers &
    peripherals'), board ('TWSE' or 'TPEx'), year-on-year growth range as fractions
    (min_yoy=0.5 means at least +50%), minimum monthly revenue in NT$, record months only, companies back to growth
    only. sort_by one of yoy, mom, ytd_yoy, vs_trend, unusual_z, revenue.

tools.name: search_filings
tools.description:
Material announcements (重大訊息) of Taiwan-listed companies, translated into English: title, summary,
    category and the Chinese subject. Search by words (English or Chinese, 3+ characters), company, category
    (e.g. 'Dividends', 'Contracts and orders', 'Investments and acquisitions') and how many days
    back (the archive starts 2026-11-01). Newest first.

tools.name: get_supply_chain
tools.description:
Supply-chain links between Taiwan-listed companies and US-listed companies, found in US annual reports (SEC
    10-K / 20-F) and reviewed by the editor: who supplies whom, competitors, partners, each with the quoted sentence
    and the filing. Give a Taiwan company (code or name) or a US company name (e.g. 'NVIDIA', 'Apple').
    relation: supplier, competitor or partner. Read each link as: a_name <relation> b_name (a is supplier of b).

tools.name: get_japan_links
tools.description:
Links between Taiwan-listed companies and Japanese companies from Taiwanese (MOPS) and Japanese (EDINET)
    filings: Japanese subsidiaries and units, Japanese shareholders, equipment bought from or sold to Japanese firms,
    joint ventures. Give a Taiwan company, a Japanese company (name or TSE code, e.g. 'Tokyo Electron' or '8035'),
    or neither for the full list.

tools.name: get_investments
tools.description:
Asset purchases and disposals announced by Taiwan-listed companies (machinery and equipment, land and
    buildings, leases, shares of subsidiaries, capital injections), parsed from their filings, with the NT$ amount,
    place, counterparty and source link. Filter by company, asset_type (e.g. 'Machinery'), kind ('acquisition' or
    'disposal'), days back and minimum NT$ amount. Largest first.

tools.name: gpu_prices
tools.description:
GPU rental prices in US$ per GPU-hour from cloud providers and marketplaces (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle,
    CoreWeave, Lambda, RunPod, Vast.ai and others), by model (e.g. 'H100 SXM', 'B200', 'RTX 4090') and price type.
    Without a model: the latest price per model and provider.

tools.name: data_status
tools.description:
What this server holds and how fresh it is: when the data was built, the latest revenue month, row counts,
    and the valid values for industry, filing category, asset type, supply relation, Japan relation and GPU model.
